brief:
The village council of Al-Mughayyir, northeast of Ramallah, issued a broad appeal to Palestinian factions on Tuesday calling for unified support against what it characterized as a sustained Israeli occupation campaign targeting the community, Shehab Wire reported. The council described the effort as part of a continuous project aimed at forcing Palestinian residents from their homes.

In its statement, the council urged various Palestinian political and social constituencies to stand alongside villagers as they confront the threat. The appeal underscores tensions in the area north of the Palestinian capital, where settlements and military operations have long created friction between Israeli authorities and Palestinian communities.
